shuffled_stage_order.note: destroys the ordering: r should collapse and T1 fail

arithmetic_growth_matched.note: linear-in-k growth with matched endpoints: BIC should prefer arithmetic (T1 fail) although r stays high

iid_random_ratios_cv015.note: boundary control: i.i.d. fluctuation about a constant mean satisfies Thompson's hypothesis (no systematic drift), so it is expected to pass; it shows the suite tolerates fluctuation up to CV ~0.15

exact_geometric_1_225.note: positive control: all four tests must pass

T1_geometric_succession.rule: median Pearson r(ln D, k) >= 0.98 and geometric beats arithmetic (BIC) in >= 80% of specimens

T2_near_constant_ratio.rule: median CV of successive ratios <= 0.15 AND in every genus the early/mid/late-third mean ratios differ by <= 10% of the mean (no systematic ontogenetic drift; Thompson p. 595 'small secondary fluctuation')

T3_fusulina_ratio_1_225.rule: Triticites (triticitid fusulinid, cf. von Moller's Fusulina) mean half-whorl ratio within 0.05 of 1.225

T4_continuous_series.rule: Monte-Carlo p >= 0.05 that a continuous (normal) ratio distribution produces an interior gap as large as observed, and every pair of genera adjacent in mean ratio has overlapping ranges
